text:
maya: quick thread 60 i'm thinking about splitting the onboarding flow into a fast ingest check vs a deeper async bench. want to align on interfaces and failure semantics before i draft the RFC. open to feedback now?
jordan: sounds useful. what's the fast check surface? load+sanity+tiny perf?
maya: yep. goal: <=30s. verify model loads, forward pass on a couple golden prompts, kv-cache basic ops for short seqs, and a small mem footprint check.
kevin: agree. we need a compact contract returned by fast-check so deep-bench can skip redoing trivial steps. propose: {status, fingerprint, quick_metrics}.
sasha: also add runtime invariants: allocator ok, no dtype-cast-exceptions, attention mask shapes. fast-check must catch fatal incompatibilities.
maya: proposal for status enum: PASS / WARN / FAIL. WARN triggers one auto-retry then a quick triage job. FAIL blocks staging. deep-bench runs full eval and perf.
devon: multi-artifact variants concern: fast-check should validate a canonical artifact only. deep-bench accepts a profile set (fp32, q8, etc.) and runs in parallel on bench fleet.
jordan: canonical artifact makes lifecycle sane. fast-check should still attempt a simple decode for quantized artifacts to catch op incompat.
kevin: infra: fast-check runs on intake worker (short-lived pod). deep-bench is a k8s job on bench GPUs. need failure-budget and timeout rules.
maya: draft descriptor snippet to include with model entry:```yaml
onboard:
  fast_check:
    timeout: 45s
    node_selector: onboard-fast
  deep_bench:
    schedule: async
    resources: bench-large
    variants: [fp32, int8]
```
sasha: nice. add a skip_deep_bench_if predicate (e.g., tiny models < 1B, or fast-check PASS+low-variance) to save cycles.
devon: telemetry: fast-check emits load_ms, peak_mem_mb, quick_quality_score. deep-bench emits full eval summaries and histograms. UI and alerts depend on stable keys.
jordan: include build/hash + cuda/cudnn versions in payload so infra regressions can be traced.
kevin: rollback flow question: if fast-check passes and deep-bench finds regression, auto-pin traffic back? create incident?
maya: prefer soft-fallback: route live traffic to previous variant, mark new variant quarantined, and auto-open ticket with deep-bench artifact.
ops-bot: bench-runner can call /incidents/create with payload {model, bench_url, brief}. PR for webhook exists.
sasha: golden prompts: central vs team-owned? golden drift will cause noise.
devon: do two-tier: canonical infra golden for runtime checks + team-owned quality sets. deep-bench runs both.
maya: actions: (1) i'll draft RFC for descriptor + PASS/WARN/FAIL semantics, (2) kevin/jordan to propose retry/fallback and failure budgets, (3) sasha/devon to propose telemetry keys and golden ownership, (4) kevin to wire ops-bot ticket flow. aim for draft in 7 days.
jordan: add conformance test harness (python script) run by fast-check to normalize outputs across runtimes.
kevin: i'll prototype a tiny container that reads the YAML descriptor and emits the summary JSON.
maya: thanks all 60 i'll post RFC tomorrow morning and drop links here. :thumbsup:
